text: Super good and nice dentist. I had minor problem and other dentist couldn’t explain me well. But this dentist, he gave me very precise explanation, and choice of treatment I needed in English. I can definitely recommend.

Went there on the 31st of December, to fix 2 broken front teeth because of a fall, charged me 4000baht for 2 teeth and on the  3rd of January, one of the front teeth that he fix, already had the filling falling off. (Did not even bite into anything hard.)

Also the whole time I didn't know if I was at the dentist or at a swimming pool, the water was splashing all over my face as well as my neck, my shirt was wet. That was how professional they are. Also had to point out the unevenness of one of the tooth when it was dome, there was a dent, that the dentist couldn't see even after I pointed it out to him and the nurse had to show it to him.
Very good service and doctor explain for take care teeth very nice 👍👍 …

This is a highly recommended clinic.
The doctor is kind and gives excellent advice. They explain the orthodontic treatment in detail, and the doctor has over 30 years of experience. If any of my friends are interested in getting braces, you can try contacting them first. The clinic's admin will be happy to assist you.

My first experience with orthodontics was that the patient didn't always show up for appointments, but the doctor was able to solve the problems consistently. It's better to consult with this doctor; the service is excellent, the doctor is gentle, and the prices are reasonable.

text: My girlfriend and I were walking behind Big C On Nut and saw a newly opened dental clinic, so we stopped by to check it out. The new clinic was very clean, and it's the third branch of OK Dental Clinic. The staff and dentists were very kind. Importantly, the prices were affordable. Thank you for the great service!
The doctor was very kind and able to control the treatment timeline. The orthodontic treatment went exactly according to the plan. I'm very happy.
The doctor was very gentle, it didn't hurt at all, he gave great advice, and the price was very affordable.
